# Third-party files in this folder

- `zxing-reader.js`, `share.js`, `zxing_reader.wasm`: zxing-wasm 3.1.5 (reader build), MIT, Ze-Zheng Wu. Wraps ZXing-C++ (Apache-2.0). One change: the import of `share.js` points at this folder.
- `../fonts/*.woff2`: Inter (latin subset) via @fontsource/inter, SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Inter Project Authors.
